name: Scale AI
tagline: Data labeling and evaluation infrastructure for frontier AI. Loop is a recruiter call, a 60-min practical coding screen, then a virtual onsite with coding, system design, a project deep dive and culture fit.
notes: Most reported: a dependency-aware task scheduler (TaskManager with add/consume, deadline priority, prerequisites), a party-planning interval problem (merge intervals per town, then idle gaps grouped by city), an object-oriented four-player card game simulation, and a grid update in the style of Game of Life. Questions are practical and multi-part; interviewers care about clean object/data modeling, stating assumptions out loud for underspecified rules, choosing the right data structure (heaps, interval merging) and testing edge cases as you go.
